> [!NOTE]
> **Scope Boundaries**:
> - **Desktop Only**: This project exclusively targets desktop browsers (1024px+). Requests for mobile/touch UI, phone layouts, or responsive mobile navigation will not be accepted.
> - **Pure BYOD**: No built-in problem datasets or web crawling/scraping mechanisms will be added. All data ingestion must remain user-provided (BYOD via JSON Lines).

## Problem statement

Is your feature request related to a problem? Please provide a clear and concise description of what the problem is.

## Proposed solution

Describe the solution you would like to see implemented, including workflow details, desktop interactions, and expected behavior.

## Alternatives considered

Describe any alternative solutions or features you have considered.

## Additional context

Add any other context, mockups, or screenshots about the feature request here.
